name: GlzTooltip
semanticRole: Provide short, non-interactive explanatory text for a control without carrying warnings, forms, or essential-only information.

material.rule: Tooltip is a compact Thick Glaze overlay. Reduced Transparency or unavailable blur resolves to Solid Glaze; the trigger remains the target, never the tooltip itself.

input.keyboard: Keyboard focus on the trigger can reveal the tooltip; Escape dismisses it without moving trigger focus.
input.focus: Opening never steals focus from the trigger.
input.hover: Pointer hover may reveal after a short delay; essential information never depends on hover.
input.press: Press behavior belongs to the trigger and the tooltip remains non-interactive.

accessibility.role: Use tooltip semantics and associate the tooltip from its trigger.
accessibility.name: Tooltip text supplements a separately named trigger rather than becoming its only accessible name.
accessibility.state: Expose visible or hidden state without selection or pressed semantics.
accessibility.keyboard: Focus-triggered disclosure works without hover and Escape dismisses it.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains on the invoking trigger while shown.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Warnings and validation errors use associated inline or error surfaces instead of a tooltip.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Open and close without nonessential scale or travel.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Use opaque Solid Glaze with an explicit boundary.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform colors with no blur or color-only meaning.
accessibility.largeText: Wrap to multiple lines and remain within the viewport at 200% text.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct visibility changes or a short crossfade.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system Canvas and CanvasText with no blur.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and decorative shadow before changing semantics or geometry.

content.overflow: Wrap short copy and clamp width before overflowing the viewport.
content.localization: Short explanatory text tolerates 30–50% expansion and may wrap.
content.rtl: Logical placement follows trigger geometry and mirrors start or end placement.

criteria: Tooltip remains compact and subordinate to its trigger.
Tooltip never becomes an interactive mini-popover.
Thick Glaze stays readable over varied content and has an opaque fallback.
